name: Unprivileged User Namespaces Restricted
description: Ensures unprivileged users cannot freely create user namespaces, which expose large amounts of kernel attack surface (netfilter, mounts) to unprivileged code. Passes when any of the following holds: kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone = 0 (Debian kernels), kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns = 1 (Ubuntu 23.10+), or user.max_user_namespaces = 0. Rootless containers and browser sandboxes need user namespaces; exclude hosts that run them.

validation.command: for f in /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone /proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces; do printf '%s=' "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo absent; done
